name: combobox
useFor: Use instead of Select when there are more than about ten choices or people know what they are looking for (an agent, a contact, webhook events). Wrap ComboboxTrigger (or ComboboxChips with ComboboxChip and ComboboxChipsInput for several values) and ComboboxContent with ComboboxInput, ComboboxList, ComboboxItem rows and ComboboxEmpty in a Combobox with value and onValueChange (multiple for several). Pass items so the closed field can show labels. To let people add a new value, render an extra item for the search text from useCombobox().
constraints: A combobox for five or fewer choices (use Select or a radio group)
A list without an empty state
source: Extrapolated from the Inkbox console (Figma 427:2715): the select trigger (Any State), the command menu and the lilac handle chip
title: Combobox
description: A pill trigger for one value, or a field with 24px corners for multiple lilac pill chips, opening a searchable menu with 16px corners.
